safety.pickles: The only pickles on disk are vae_128d_48k.pth (MOSS) and svd_bases.pt (SA3). I read their pickle opcodes with pickletools: VAE holds only collections.OrderedDict, torch._utils._rebuild_tensor_v2, torch.FloatStorage; svd_bases holds the same plus torch.HalfStorage. The MOSS adapter replaces DAC.load by a loader with torch.load(weights_only=True) and an empty allow-list (asserted); the log of my re-run shows 'VAE loaded with weights_only=True: missing=0 unexpected=0'. All other MOSS weights are safetensors; the only other torch.load in the package (utils.py:83) has weights_only=True; trainers/utils.py:610 (torch.load without weights_only) and dac_vae.py:51 (np.load allow_pickle for .dac files) are training/export code that is not reached. SA3: model.safetensors and t5gemma are safetensors; svd_bases.pt is never opened by the adapter; the package opens it only with weights_only=True (loader.py:91, bake_dora.py:128, diffusion.py:102); lora/utils.py:304 uses weights_only=False but only for LoRA checkpoints that are never loaded.

checks.choice: screen.py re-run on a copy of the raw files with models on cpu and the six skips: same 16 chosen ids and source files, same status and reason for all 144 files, listening copies sample-identical (0.0 max diff; the wav bytes differ only in header). Without the six --skip arguments the script would pick differently, so the README sentence that screen.py chooses is not literally true. Rejections: clipped 40 (all SA3), cut-off 11 (all MOSS, gear 8, shield 3), several-events 2 (one MOSS, one SA3; 4 clipped files also have several events), 53 in all as reported. problems: Level inside a family: LUFS is equal within 0.02 but the true peaks of the sixteen differ within a family (thruster -23.6 to -12.4 dBFS, hull -19.5 to -15.0, gear -23.7 to -15.1, shield -12.3 to -9.9), and the selector measured 5 to 16 dB spread of sounding level. A listener comparing candidates in a family will hear unequal loudness.

src_1_hull_1_moss reaches -33.19 LUFS, not -34.0: set_level in tools/audio/synth/levels.py applies one gain computed from a gated BS.1770 measure and never checks the result. I believe the gate threshold moves with the gain for a short event followed by a quiet tail; I did not prove that.

src_3_gear_1_moss (gear_2 s16) is cut at the family length of 3.8 s while the level is within 0.2 dB of its maximum (100 ms window before the fade; RESULTS.md says 6.6 dB), so the sound is ended by a 30 ms fade, not by itself. src_3_gear_3_moss (-19 dB) and src_4_shield_1_moss (-34 dB) are also capped but decayed. screen.py rejects raw files that are cut off by the end of the file but not events cut off by its own length cap.

OpenGameArt contributed no candidate (fetch.py allows only kenney.nl and nasa.gov and the edit was refused), so slot 3 of every family is a second MOSS pick and the page offers two sources, not three.

The oga builder fetched 12 archives (about 17 MB) with curl into a temp folder outside the repository, not through fetch.py; the README (rule 8) wants fetch.py. They are not in the repository, are deliverables of nothing and should be deleted if the owner does not approve the fetch.py change.
svd_bases.pt (1.27 GB pickle) was downloaded with the SA3 repository although no adapter path opens it.

The six hand skips (screen.json skippedAsPick) are documented in RESULTS.md, but the sixteen cannot be reproduced by running screen.py without them, and some reasons are about spectrum features (a 12.5 kHz line, a 50 Hz sine).
